title: Tsūkaku Tantei Tsūtenji Natsume, Isekai Yurutto Survival Seikatsu Manga Both End
content: The November issue of Kadokawa 's Monthly Dragon Age magazine published the final chapter of Yasu Hiromoto and Sayaka Itsuki 's Tsūkaku Tantei Tsūtenji Natsume ( The pain sensation detective: Natsume [splendid case files by the five senses] ) manga on Friday.
author: ANN

title: Black Summoner Manga Ends With 200th Chapter
content: J-Novel Club has licensed both the novels and the manga adaptation, and is releasing both in English digitally. Yen Press ' JNC imprint publishes the manga in English physically. Yen Press describes the manga's story: While being transmigrated to another world, Kelvin gave up his memories for powerful new abilities.
author: ANN

title: Avatar: Seven Havens Producer Confirms Season 3 & 4 Are Already in Production (Exclusive)
content: Avatar: Seven Havens just confirmed that the new sequel series has been renewed for a third and fourth season, but it turns out that those future seasons are much further along in production than fans might have expected.

title: Glacier Bay License Oedo-chan of Moguraya, A Vase of Life, Faraway Blue, More Manga
content: Glacier Bay Books announced on Sunday the following new manga licenses: Oedo-chan works at Moguraya with Captain. Captain is a mole, and Oedo-chan is a stray cat. The world can be so big, so cruel and mysterious. But Oedo-chan is a hard worker, she isn't afraid of anything. And you shouldn't be either.

title: Dark Crunchyroll Fantasy Confirms Season 2 Return After 4 Years – Watch Trailer
content: A dark fantasy series you can now find streaming with Crunchyroll has confirmed it’s finally coming back for a second season after four long years, and a new trailer is helping to show it off for the first real time.
author: ComicBook

title: Manga Creator Masako Watanabe Dies at 97
content: Watanabe was born in Tokyo on May 16, 1929. She debuted in 1952 with the story "Suama-chan." She launched the Himegoto manga in 2020 at the age of 91. Watanabe specialized in shojo and josei during her long career. She won the 16th Shogakukan Manga Award in 1971 for her series Glass no Shiro ( Glass Castle ) .
author: ANN

title: Bleach Takes Over Japan With Special Promo Ahead of Anime Finale – Watch
content: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War is nearing closer than ever to the release of the anime’s final episodes ever, and it has taken over Japan with a cool new promo to get fans ready for the grand finale. Bleach made its return earlier this Summer with the final wave of episodes to bring its anime to an ultimate end.

title: Black Clover Creator Returns With New Look at Asta’s Wizard King Makeover
content: Black Clover ‘s creator has returned with a new look at Asta’s Wizard King makeover following the manga’s original finale, and it’s to get ready for a cool new art book release coming to Japan soon.
